title: Getting more vivid
content: Has anyone else been visiting a smallish town/city with bars and restaurants? I wanna say it’s on a cobblestone road and there’s lots of shops and small businesses. I had such a vivid dream there last night where I went out to eat at one of the breakfast spots, and I passed a bunch of night life and dive bars on the way. It’s so annoying because I made it a point to read the signs of the places in my dream, but when I woke up I can’t remember them. I want to say one of them was called the “tap house” and it had large blue letters for the sign in front. The breakfast spot I went to was super busy and cramped and had a small upstairs area also.
